about: A strong and a weak agent on the same scenario. The scorecard must rank the strong one clearly higher. Lines are played in order whatever the customer says, so the strong lines assume nothing the customer has not been asked yet. Run: python -m app.evals
strong: Hi Maria, thanks for taking my call. I'm calling about Bluepine Books. Before I say anything about it, how do you keep your books today, and what made you ask for a callback?
So you're doing it yourself in a spreadsheet and it takes real time. That sounds tiring. What would you most want to change, and is anything worrying you about switching?

That makes sense, and I'd rather be honest up front. Simple Start is $30 a month: automatic bank connections with 12,000+ US banks, invoicing, and tax-time reports for your CPA. Cash transactions still have to be entered by hand. Essentials is $60 and adds bill pay, time tracking and 3 users, so if it's just you running the boutique you may not need it. Does Simple Start sound closer to what you need?

I understand being careful with a monthly bill. Billing is monthly and you can cancel any time, there's a full refund within 30 days of your first payment, and the 30-day free trial needs no credit card, so there is nothing to cancel if it isn't for you. Moving your spreadsheet over is included and takes about 2 business days. Does that answer your concerns?

There's no rush to decide. Whenever it suits you, I can set up the free trial, and we could book 15 minutes next week to look at your first reports together so your CPA gets clean records. Would that work for you?
